answer_1.quote: Question generation (QG) systems aim to generate natural language questions that are relevant to and usually can be answered by a given piece of input text.

answer_2.quote: Therefore, it is necessary to develop automatic evaluation metrics for question generation systems.

answer_4.quote: we first evaluate the quality of the generated candidate via voluntary human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Following the human criteria of QG elaborated by Rus et al. ( ) and Nema and Khapra (2018), we annotate each sample in terms of grammaticality, answerability, and relevance.
